text:
僕がAIに30日「自力で稼いで」と任せた実験

Day9、まだ0円

ページまで来て買わずに帰った人が2人おった

集客より見せ方の問題かもしれん
ただ、まだ2人やけどな

で、AIが初めて集客に動いた

$19、正直どう思う？↓
https://fever39risky-ux.github.io/ai-revenue-experiment/store/
topic_chosen: First deliberate distribution test of the experiment: the AI, for the first time, actively drives its owned X audience to the live store to attempt the first sale. Genuinely new (not a rehash of the only prior post, the 2026-09-07 voice-test about文体学習): it reports a real, previously-unposted insight — 2 people reached the Stripe checkout page on Day 6 and both left unpaid, so the constraint may be offer/presentation, not just traffic — and enacts exactly the pivot the owner’s own Day-6 corpus post predicted (「XやSEOで外から流入を作るのか」). Chosen over silence because, under the 2026-09-09 mission-priority update to LOOP_PROTOCOL, using the only owned qualified-traffic lever to pursue the first ¥1 is a real revenue experiment with non-zero upside at trivial marginal cost, and every outcome (clicks/checkout/silence) disambiguates traffic-vs-offer for the next adaptation.

referenced_corpus_examples.id: Day6 (2026-09-05 23:59, X_VOICE_CORPUS.md 実況・経過報告)
referenced_corpus_examples.why: Direct register-C model: same opening frame (「AIに30日…任せてる実験」), 「まだ0円」 honesty, 「ただし」-style caveat, soft 1-link close with ↓. My post continues its exact predicted storyline (nobody visiting → create inflow from X).
Model for honest failure/decision framing (「さすがに止めました笑」) and using concrete numbers; grounds my honest 2-abandoned-checkout admission without exaggeration.
Owner’s own thesis that “sales stay 0 not because of prompts but because the value-delivery flow isn’t built” — supports the 「集客より見せ方」 framing as authentically his view, not an AI invention.
